title: ContextRequest
description: A targeted, bounded request for more repository information, issued by the Context Analysis Agent when the Context Packet does not contain a project fact needed for the task. Ask for one specific file, configuration, directory, dependency or document; never request a full repository scan. Provide at least one of `path` or `query`.

type.description: Kind of information requested: `source_file` (read one source file), `configuration` (read a config file such as tsconfig.json or a CI workflow), `directory_summary` (list/summarise one directory), `dependency_details` (version and usage of one dependency), `documentation` (read one documentation file).

path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path (e.g. `src/payments/webhooks.ts`). Must not be absolute and must not contain `..` segments.

query.description: What to look for when no exact path is known, e.g. a dependency name (`stripe`) or a symbol (`createPaymentIntent`).

reason.description: Why this information is needed for the task, in one sentence. It is shown to the root agent and recorded with the run.

priority.description: `required` when the skill cannot be compiled correctly without it; `optional` when it would only improve the skill.
